image:image.image:title: Open box
image:image.image:caption: An open box tipped towards you, with stars and a halftone swoosh rising out of it.

image:image.image:title: Robot in a party hat
image:image.image:caption: A robot's head wearing a cone hat, one antenna bent over, joined by a segmented cable to a plug on the left.

image:image.image:title: API cloud
image:image.image:caption: A cloud lettered Api, with one arrow curving up into it and another curving down and away.

image:image.image:title: DNA helix
image:image.image:caption: A DNA double helix drawn as two twisting ribbons, halftone shading behind the rungs.

image:image.image:title: Hiker between pines
image:image.image:caption: A walker in a knitted hat striding between two halftone pine trees, leaning on a long pole.

image:image.image:title: Backpack
image:image.image:caption: A figure in a patterned cap seen in profile, carrying a large rounded backpack, a long line sweeping away behind.

image:image.image:title: Headphones
image:image.image:caption: A face with a wide fringe wearing over-ear headphones, the ear cups filled with halftone.

image:image.image:title: Confused head
image:image.image:caption: A head in profile with loops and squiggles rising off the top and small spirals drifting away.

image:image.image:title: Star burst
image:image.image:caption: A solid inked star burst with uneven points.

image:image.image:title: Circle loop
image:image.image:caption: A hand-drawn loop circling back on itself, the kind used to ring something on a page.

image:image.image:title: Curved arrow
image:image.image:caption: A thick hand-drawn arrow curving in from the right and pointing left.
